# Purpose

The primary objective of the `sales_analysis.R` script is to automate the ingestion, data cleaning, and summary aggregation of monthly retail store transaction data. It prepares clean metrics for dashboard consumption.

## Dependencies

Before running the script functions, load the necessary core packages:

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
